verdict.rationale: Square has a dedicated first-party Idempotency page under its common API patterns, and its llms.txt states that "every write endpoint accepts an idempotency key." That is the core mechanism for safely retrying payment-creating requests without duplicate charges. missing for 10: detailed documentation of retry semantics (dedupe window, behavior on reused keys with different payloads), SDK examples showing idempotency keys in use, independent or hands-on corroboration that retries never produce duplicate charges.
